summary: ASN Potato is a potato processor in Dronten, Flevoland, the Netherlands, founded in 1995. It sorts, stores, peels and packs fresh potatoes on its own premises and supplies them peeled or unpeeled, cut or whole. It works with Polder Potato on processing and delivery, and orders range from five kilos to five tonnes.
products: Superbonken: large potatoes for cutting fresh fries
Peeled or unpeeled, packed or unpacked
facts: Developed a peeling method in 1994 and has since refined cold peeling
Order sizes from five kilos to five tonnes
Potatoes come from long-term growers in the surrounding region
